correctness.rationale: The classified uniform sample is a grid with the divisor indices removed and one exceptional ordinary semigroup added. Branch-wise counting and truncation prove the uniform bound. Branch masses are telescoping, and beta-free elementary integrals give the stated moments. Finite closure enumeration tests the exact input and is not a proof of convergence.
